The petitioners are before this Court calling in question the proceedings in S.C.No.959/2021 pending on the file of the LXXI Additional City Civil and Sessions Judge, Bengaluru City for offences punishable under Sections 498A, 307, 506 read with Section 34 of the IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

sentences.text:

3.

Therefore, interference at this stage would run foul of the judgment of the Apex Court in the case of Minakshi Bala v. Sudhir Kumar1.
5.
The learned counsel would submit that the complainant is not at all appearing before the concerned Court for conclusion of the trial.
The submission is noted and the concerned Court is directed to conclude the proceedings, in accordance with law, within six months from the date of receipt of the copy of the order, if not earlier.
7. With the aforesaid observations, the petition stands disposed.
Ordered accordingly.
